name: Demons
overview: Demons (Russian: Бесы, also translated as The Possessed or The Devils) is a powerful 1872 masterpiece by Fyodor Dostoevsky. It stands as one of the most politically charged and prophetic novels in world literature, serving as a dark satire and psychological critique of nihilism, radicalism, and the rise of revolutionary movements in 19th-century Russia.
